column1: # Forbidden terms (checked by scripts/scan-forbidden.sh, rule "term"). One term per line, TAB-separated:
# fragments: the pieces of the term joined with "|". The pieces are joined with nothing when the check runs, so the term itself is never written in this file.
# replacement: the word to use instead (shown when the check fails).
# exception: fragments of a longer text that contains the term but is not the term (a line containing it is not reported). Empty: none.
# Lines starting with # are ignored, and so is the header line whose first column is ID.
